name: Celebi Event
description: Crystal's GS Ball quest, rebuilt on Gold, Silver and Crystal: the GS BALL as a real key item, the receptionist catching you on the way out of the GOLDENROD POKeMON CENTER, KURT studying the ball at his bench and then running out of the house with it, the hand-back outside his door in AZALEA TOWN, and the ILEX FOREST shrine at (8,22) where Celebi descends to the player and the Lv30 battle begins. Every line, coordinate, movement, flag transition and sound is transcribed from pret/pokecrystal's own map scripts, and where the carts have no counterpart the mod supplies it: the receptionist, KURT_OUTSIDE and the forest Kurt are spawned, and Crystal's coord tile is watched through world.stepped because a Gen 2 mod cannot add a coord event. The shrine cutscene plays the whole of special CelebiShrineEvent rather than just its battle type -- 160 iterations of two frames, the player's '!' and one step back with fix_facing held, then the descent with its decaying-cosine sway -- and the battle uses the engine's own BATTLETYPE_CELEBI. Quest state lives in the mod's own save bucket, never in the event-flag space, because EVENT_FOREST_IS_RESTLESS and its neighbours are Crystal-only ids that mean other things in Gold and Silver. The descent sprite ships: assets/celebi.png is the cart's own 16x64 overworld graphic for Celebi, re-cut in the four-shade form the engine bakes through the sprite's own PAL_OW_GREEN, so one sheet draws correctly on all three carts. It is carried because nothing can derive it -- Gold has no Celebi overworld sprite for the engine's extractor to cut, so the graphic is not a row of OverworldSprites and is not in any import -- see assets/README.md. Delete the file and the shrine event still runs end to end, minus the sprite. Two switches under MODS: reach the event without the HALL OF FAME, and skip KURT's 24-hour wait. It runs on all three Gen 2 carts. Crystal already carries the GS BALL in its own item list, so there the mod does not register a second one -- the cart's own record is used -- and everything else, the two switches included, runs there as it does on Gold and Silver. The bag is the authority on the ball either way: KURT answers to a GS BALL in the bag rather than to the mod's own stage, and the receptionist declines to hand over a second one, so the ball the cart's own event gave is recognised too.
